question: In which Olympic games did Milkha Singh finish fourth in the 400 m Running final?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rome Olympic games.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The men's 400 meters was an event at the **1960 Summer Olympics in Rome.**
 
• Milkha Singh represented India in three Olympics from **1956-1964.**
 
• He was awarded the **Padma Shri,** **India's fourth-highest civilian honour**, in recognition of his sporting winnings.
 
• Milkha Singh was a great athlete.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5396e30171b4057cbececebbcbfb5a3573a650c6d3bd734f00f66243e06bd61c.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Olympic Games are **a global sports festival, organized every four years**.​ 
 
• The main motives are to **cultivate human beings, through sport, and provide global peace.**
 
• Summer Games and Winter Games are arranged** Seperetaly.**
